scope: Read-only review of Main/Surface contact integration, shared HP, pose ordering, source-only and legacy boundaries, deferred fuel/time, pending-state immutability, save/backup/reload, diagnostics and multi-frame Menu touch ownership. The only file written by this closeout is this report.

checks.finding: Source contact is enabled only in the full source layout with source hyperdrive and source terrain. Terrain/manual and explicit city-floor proxy consume the bounded core; nonfloor wall and legacy contact paths remain separate.

Resolved pose is checked before shared raw HP requests; Surface.finish_source_contact commits the pose and consumes the queue without a second SI percent impact penalty. A fatal result clears deferred work before destruction/save.

checks.previous_issue: Inferring nozzle commands after native contact/rebase projected the powered impulse through a different attitude and could change clamped force words and fuel debit.
checks.resolution: Commands are captured immediately after Surface.step and before applying native contact.

checks.previous_issue: A failed original contact frame could retain its clock/impulse but lose its fuel/surface/camera/save continuation on retry.
checks.resolution: The original seconds, force words, frame and landed state are retained; a successful retry clears and finishes that stored interval exactly once without applying retry dt.

checks.previous_issue: Retry after failed contact advanced gear/time and could be counted as a new scheduler step.
checks.resolution: Pending work is handled before W/S polling and plan_frame; direct _tick callers also resolve pending before advancing gear, clock or fuel.

checks.previous_issue: Brake/gear/throttle/fuel commands and LOD publication could change live operands or terrain between a failed contact and retry.
checks.resolution: Body/frame identity is checked; physical controls and runtime fuel/service commands are blocked while pending; geometry publication is frozen. Restore/new-game remain explicit recovery replacements.

checks.previous_issue: Pending state must not overwrite the last valid save or produce an apparently valid backup envelope containing an empty game payload; a reload instruction needs a reachable action.
checks.resolution: Pending payload/save writes are rejected; backup stays blank and allows importing an existing code; recovery menu exposes a strict last-save reload; commit/new-game clear contact error and deferred state.

checks.previous_issue: A legitimate native rank-one result was rejected together with its position, velocity and F953 requests.
checks.resolution: Keep the previous phone Quaternion only when the native output is finite and rank deficient, while preserving exact kernel raw output and all other effects. Reflected nondegenerate outputs remain rejected; facts identify the projection policy and raw basis.

existing_native_fixture_observation.method: Read an existing independently generated native fixture; no fixture regeneration or core execution in this review.

checks.previous_issue: Repeated retry notices could evict the original error and candidate from the bounded256-line logger.
checks.resolution: Error notice and event are emitted on reason change only; current error, pending candidate and deferred interval are included in diagnostic samples.

checks.previous_issue: Disable-all then reenable-menu released Menu pointer ownership every display frame; unconditional release_inputs on retries also canceled a held recovery touch.
checks.resolution: During pending state Menu is never set input_allowed=false by the per-frame bulk update, while other pointer buttons remain blocked. release_inputs runs only when entering a new error reason. Menu action itself emits independently of the physical actions_enabled gate.
checks.dynamic_validation: Not executed by this reviewer; the actual press->process/retry frames->release regression is owned by the Main test agent.

checks.finding: Graphics preview is explicitly rejected while pending, including when ordinary saving is disabled, preventing temporary model replacement from discarding an unresolved contact.

limits_and_known_adapters: This is static review, not execution or proof of whole-game DOS parity.
The geometry/contact event bridge and city-floor radial proxy are explicit phone adapters; the full F569/F570/F576/F577/F578 classification/frame/collision pipeline remains outside this integration.
Nonfloor city/building wall response and legacy flight/surface contact continue to use their documented existing rules.
The rank-deficient native orientation uses an explicitly reported phone-Quaternion projection fallback; the raw source matrix is retained rather than repaired.
No Android device, APK, GPU capture, tests or native oracle were executed by this reviewer. Release validation and the actual multi-frame Menu touch regression belong to other agents.
external_test_results: Not restated as reviewer results; use the separately hashed validation reports from the responsible agents.
